Name: Wooden Picture Frames
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This is a content pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10704]Custom Picture Frames[/url]. It requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].

It adds four new wall-hanging furniture:

[list]
[*]Wooden 1x2 Frame
[*]Wooden 2x2 Frame
[*]Wooden 3x2 Frame
[*]Wooden 3x3 Frame
[/list]
To set a picture in a frame, see the documentation for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10704]Custom Picture Frames[/url]﻿.

You can buy the frames at Robin's store for 100 each.

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
